title: Missing Validation of Yield Strategy Return Values
description: The claim() function does not verify that actual tokens received from yield strategies match the expected yield amounts. If a strategy returns less than expected, claimers may overpay.
impact: Claimers may overpay if strategies misbehave or have rounding issues. However, this only harms voluntary participants who choose to interact with misconfigured strategies.
attackPath: Yield strategy reports X tokens available
Claimer calculates payment based on X
Strategy actually transfers Y < X tokens
Claimer paid for X but received Y
recommendation: Add balance checks before and after claiming from strategies. Compare actual received amount to expected and either revert or adjust payment accordingly.
